text.tspan: A structural map of 300 backbone layers
Open the image to inspect layer-index tooltips. Categories are labeled below each strip.
Blue: Dense/CSA/Reuse; purple: MoE; amber: Full indexer/HCA/Reindex; green: KV Full; gray: Shared/SWA.
